title: What is claimable vs not claimable
keywords: claimable not claimable cake smashed frozen defrosted left at door wrong unit
body: Claimable: cake fully smashed with photo (full) or partly smashed (partial); pastries toppled (partial); frozen item delivered 5+ hrs after pickup (full, excl. non-perishables); frozen item left at door with no notification (full); wrong unit/address, unrecoverable (full).
Not claimable: frozen item defrosted though delivered on time (product issue); left at door after SMS/WhatsApp/call to recipient; left at door with pickup SMS sent via CM.com.
